name: Kestrel Crop Tee
description:
A clean, slightly oversized crop tee cut to hit just above the hip, made from a mid-weight cotton-modal blend that drapes softly without clinging. Kestrel is a mid-tier streetwear label with roots in the Tier 3 arts district — their aesthetic is restrained, almost deliberately quiet. The tee comes in a range of muted naturals and urban greys, occasionally punctuated by a seasonal run in a saturated color. The only branding is a small embossed 'K' at the interior neckline. No logo on the outside. The hem is finished with a clean single-needle stitch.

This is the shirt you wear when you've figured out what you like and stopped needing to announce it. It fits well with high-waisted trousers, layered under an open shirt, or alone on a warm night in the upper districts. Kestrel has a quiet following among designers, artists, and the kind of Tier 3 professional who has strong opinions about fabric weight but would never say so at a party.
what_it_says: You have taste that doesn't announce itself. You spent more on this shirt than people realize, and that's exactly how you want it.
story_hooks: Kestrel's cotton-modal supplier is a small collective farm in what was once southern Ontario — they're being pressured by a corponation agricultural subsidiary to sell, and Kestrel's founder is quietly funding resistance efforts.

A limited run of Kestrel Crop Tees in a specific rust-orange colorway became an unintentional identifier for a Tier 3 social movement — now Kestrel's lawyers are trying to figure out how to handle the association without alienating either side.
A character receives a Kestrel tee as a gift from someone who knows them very well — the color chosen says something specific about how the giver sees them.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately understated crop tee with a soft, relaxed silhouette that suggests confidence without effort. Hits just above the hip, creating clean sightlines. The overall impression is refined minimalism—the kind of piece that disappears into a wardrobe and becomes essential.
physical_description.fit: Slightly oversized through the chest and shoulders, with a straight drop to the cropped hem. Not tight, not baggy—designed to skim the body without compression. Works layered or solo.
physical_description.primary_material: Cotton-modal blend, mid-weight. The modal gives it a subtle drape and whisper-soft hand; the cotton provides structure and breathability.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, buttery surface with a slight natural nap. Finished with a clean single-needle stitch visible along the hem and armholes—evidence of careful construction.
physical_description.color_scheme: Restrained palette of muted naturals (cream, warm grey, oatmeal, taupe) with occasional seasonal saturated drops (dusty sage, muted rust, cool charcoal). No multi-color blocking—monochromatic or nearly so.
distinctive_features: Embossed 'K' logo at interior neckline only—invisible when worn
No external branding or visible graphic design
Cropped length calibrated to hit precisely at hip
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 aspirational—affordable quality with design philosophy above its price point. Signals someone who values substance over visibility.
physical_description.cultural_context: Arts district, design-conscious working class, creative professionals. Worn by people who have moved beyond brand signaling into personal aesthetic. Common in Tier 3 studios, cafes, and gallery openings. Quietly respected in corpo offices as 'that clean shirt someone wore.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but maintained. Soft from wear, edges slightly relaxed. Never looks new or precious, but never sloppy. Shows respectful aging.

image_prompt: Kestrel Crop Tee on a lean androgynous model with subtle augmentation scarring visible at collarbone. Muted warm-grey colorway. Shot against a brick wall in the GLMZ arts district, moody blue-hour lighting creating subtle shadows across the fabric. Model styled with high-waisted utility trousers in black, hands relaxed at sides. Shallow depth of field emphasizes the soft cotton-modal drape and clean stitching. Cyberpunk fashion editorial, intimate scale, no logos visible. --ar 2:3 --v 6
